channel.itunes:summary: Did your favorite artist just break a record or a heart? The charts are screaming, and we have the inside story you won't hear anywhere else.
channel.description: The latest music trends, chart updates, and star stories from Billboard and beyond. Stay updated with the Pop Culture.

item.title: Artists With the Most No. 1 Albums on the Billboard 200: The Beatles, Future & More
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the Billboard Breakdown! I'm your host, and we've got some exciting news to share. Future's latest album, 'The Real Me', has debuted at number one on the Billboard 200 chart, marking his 12th chart-topper. That's a huge milestone, and it solidifies Future's position as one of the most successful rappers in the game."
[Short music transition]
Host: "With this latest achievement, Future becomes the rap act with the third-most number one albums on the chart. And if you're keeping track, this is his fifth consecutive number one album, dating back to 'I Never Liked You' in 2022. His first number one album on the Billboard 200 was 'DS2' back in 2015."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The Real Me was released on July 9, and its lead single 'Radio' has already made waves, hitting the top 25 on both Hot Rap Songs and Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs. Future's on a roll, and we can't wait to see what's next for him."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's it for this episode of the Billboard Breakdown. Thanks for tuning in, and don't forget to follow us on social media for all the latest chart news and updates. See you next time!"
